Welcome to Eggar’s School
Our Vision & Values
Belong
Eggar’s is a small school with a big heart where every child is known and valued. Relationships are strong between staff and students, creating a happy community of great learners, inspired to discover, to explore, and to grow.
Aspire
With a long history dating back to 1642, we have an established reputation for academic success and are very proud of the results our students achieve year after year.
Achieve
We also strive for wellbeing, enrichment, and participation in the Arts and Design and Technology, Sport and Student Leadership. This is alongside academic excellence in a broad range of subjects such as English, Maths, Science, Modern Foreign Languages and Computing.

Welcome to our new website
We are pleased to announce the launch of the new Eggar's School website, designed and developed by school website design agency Cleverbox.
We would welcome your views and feedback on the new website.

Announcements

Vision & Values
We hold firmly to our values of Belong, Aspire, Achieve and are committed to ensuring that every child is able to secure outstanding outcomes.
Belong:
At Eggar's, we see all our students as individuals with their own unique strengths and exciting potential. We enable them to find their place at Eggar's and to know that they belong. Visitors comment on the warm community feel we have at the school which enhances our students' experience and reflects the emphasis we place on nurture, mutual respect and sense of belonging. Relationships between teachers and students are strong at Eggar's and student leadership plays a key role in helping us continue to make our school even better. Our students take pride in their school during their time with us and beyond, and we love to keep in touch with our ever-growing Alumni Association to celebrate their ongoing achievements, providing inspiration for future generations.
Aspire:
Our expectations of all students are high and we help them to understand and meet those standards every day. We are immensely proud of our school culture and insist on excellent attitudes to learning because we care deeply about the education of every student and about the fantastic possibilities ahead of them. We have a team of highly skilled, caring teachers who provide the right balance of support and challenge so that students develop a deep sense of self-belief and are ambitious about their own aspirations. We are passionate about the role we play in encouraging students to become the very best version of themselves, offering an extensive programme of enrichment, personal development and co-curricular activities as well as expert guidance on careers and further education. The students are constantly reminded of the bright futures they have available to them and are taught how to develop the skills and attributes needed to make every moment count.
Achieve:
As a school, we have a well-established reputation for academic excellence, sporting prowess and exceptional talent in Music and the Performing Arts. We expect our students to reach their full potential across the curriculum and will help them every step of the way to be happy, confident, successful individuals ready to make a positive contribution to the world around them. We know that achieving outstanding results unlocks the door to a wealth of opportunities and we firmly believe in the relentless pursuit of excellence in teaching and learning so that every student leaves us with exactly what they need for their next chapter.

Welcome
A Welcome from the Head Teacher
It is a pleasure to lead Eggar’s School and I love coming to work every day. I have high expectations of every student because I care about their futures and believe in their potential.
We are a friendly and vibrant school in the heart of Hampshire. Set in a magnificent 38-acre site, the campus is an impressive environment where students can focus on their learning and thrive in all aspects of school life. Holding firmly to our school values of Belong, Aspire, Achieve, we are committed to ensuring that every child is able to experience success at Eggar’s, whatever success looks like for them as individuals.
Relationships are strong between staff and students, creating a happy community of curious learners inspired to discover, to explore and to grow. We believe that classrooms should be calm and purposeful and that students should be free to learn without distraction.
Our reputation is well established for academic excellence, sporting prowess and exceptional creativity in the visual and performing arts.
The transition from primary to secondary school is made much easier by the warm, caring and supportive atmosphere at Eggar’s. As early as Years 4 and 5 with our bespoke Discover Programme, we love getting to know our future students and helping them feel at home in a place where they will be nurtured to grow and succeed.
As Ofsted commented, “Students enjoy being at school. They are happy, and they know that they will be welcomed every day and to each lesson.” We are very proud of the team of highly specialist teachers at Eggar’s who are “experts in their field and enthuse students to want to learn more” (Ofsted 2024). We inspire leaders of the future through extensive ambassador and student leadership opportunities.
We are ambitious and aspirational for all students, expecting them to leave us with exceptional outcomes, prepared for their next steps in education or employment. That is why we pay close attention to shaping our students’ characters and to their intellectual development.
We are particularly proud of our unique extracurricular offering, the Eggar’s Experience, where students engage in a range of clubs, events, trips and visits beyond the classroom to build their confidence, make friends, develop new skills and widen their horizons. Our House system is an integral part of the school and provides many memorable moments of fun and healthy competition where students collaborate across year groups to battle it out for the prestigious House Cup!
Our greatest endorsement comes from our school community. Here is what our pupils, parents, and staff have to say about their experiences with us.
Do come and visit us to see for yourself what makes Eggar's so special. Take a walk around our beautiful site with its exceptional facilities and watch our students and staff in action. Register for a tour by calling (01420) 541194 or email enquiries@eggars.hants.sch.uk.
I look forward to meeting you and giving you a warm Eggar’s welcome.
Register for a tour by calling or email:
enquiries@eggars.hants.sch.uk

Aspire
At Eggar’s we are committed to nurturing the abilities of all our students, both inside and outside the classroom. Our Aspire Programme will build on the work we have started and will continue to provide varied and inspiring opportunities for all students to get involved in.
Within the classroom, our broad and inclusive curriculum is designed specifically with challenge in mind, allowing all students to reach their full potential and we ensure we are up to date on the latest methods in order to aid the progression of our students.
We identify exceptional students across all curriculum areas to make sure they are aware of all subject-specific provision they can benefit from through our Aspire Programme. They may also be asked to participate in student voice and be part of mentoring programmes as they move further up the school.
Aspire works in collaboration Eggar’s Experience to provide a variety of extra-curricular activities when possible, including, but not limited to:
Arkwright Scholarship Programme - Eggar's School
GCSE Statistics - Eggar's School
Guest Speaker Lectures - Eggar's School
Rotary Club Youth Speaks - UCA Farnham

Language Leaders - Eggar's School
STEM Science Trip - Qinetiq, Farnborough

Entry to high level sporting events

For more information or to enquire about guest speaker opportunities, please get in touch with Mr C Michael via enquiries@eggars.hants.sch.uk stating Aspire in the subject line.

Careers Programme
What is Careers Education and why is it important?
At Eggar’s we intend to foster a culture of belonging, aspiration and achievement where every student is happy, healthy and equipped with the skills, knowledge, and confidence to pursue their chosen career pathways and succeed in an evolving world of work.
We are commitment to providing career guidance and support to empower our students to make informed decisions about their future pathways. Our programme of Careers Education is designed to ensure that all students have access to high-quality careers education, information, advice and guidance that will help them be successful.
What do students learn in Careers Education?
In Careers Education, our students learn:
To identify personal strengths, interests, and values.
To explore different job sectors and roles.
Summary of curriculum content
Careers Education features throughout our school curriculum, with subject areas making use of the Gatsby Framework to allow students to link their learning to future outcomes and career pathways. Within the Eggar’s Pastoral Curriculum we encourage students to celebrate national events, such as National Careers Week and National Apprenticeships Week by participating in assemblies and tutor time PSHE activities.
Each student will also receive specific Careers Education within the PSHE curriculum, with one unit of work being dedicated specifically to this throughout the year. College assemblies and visits are also a key part of our curriculum offer, ensuring that students have multiple opportunities to engage with our partner establishments whilst at Eggar’s.
Belonging at Eggar’s: Understanding the transition to secondary school and how their own sense of self is impacted by the goals we set.
Careers & the Community: How life choices help shape careers, including different types & patterns of work.
Setting Goals: Analysing your key skills for employment & the benefits to exploring career options.
The World of Work: Exploring the types of careers/college courses available and how to make the most of support for the future.
Next Steps: Developing a sense of self in which to apply for colleges that will help achieve future career aspirations
Careers Guidance and Advice
At Eggar’s we offer at least two encounters with a qualified Careers Advisor to every student before they leave us in Yr11. We have two qualified members of staff who conduct both 1:1 and small group careers appointments, offering relevant information for all pathways, including apprenticeships and vocational training.
As part of our commitment to Careers Education, we have developed close links to our local FE providers. Students in Yr10 have the opportunities to visit establishments as part of a whole cohort enrichment programme, allowing students to experience taster sessions of courses they have expressed an interest in. We have also partnered with Peter Symonds College, allowing our students to have some piece of mind that they will be called to interview should they wish to apply for a place in Year 12.
Learning beyond the classroom
Eggar’s School prioritises students first-hand experience of the work place, which is why we have a 5 day work experience (WEX) week scheduled for Yr10 students annually. We operate a self-placement scheme in partnership with EBP South, to allow students to take control of their own experiences and engagement with the workplace. We believe that this is an invaluable opportunity for students to build upon their personal preferences for a career, whilst experiencing the realities of working hours, workplace environments and how to contribute to wider teams.
In 2026, Yr10 will complete WEX between Monday 18 and Friday 22 May. Students have had an assembly on self-placement and parents were invited to attend a webinar. Slides from these can be found on the attachments, as well as a copy of the self-placement form that needs to be completed and returned to confirm WEX placement.

Remote Learning
What is 'remote learning'?
Remote learning refers to the delivery of curriculum provision for students unable to attend school due to school closures or restrictions on attendance, or where school access for students is restricted.â€¯
Remote Learning is not the same as 'home learning', set for all students. For information on home learning, pleaseâ€¯click here.
Whole cohort remote learning provision
In the event of a partial or full school closure, students working from home will receive tasks through Arbor Assignments. Some teachers may also direct students to access work via Microsoft Teams.
Teachers will share work for the classes they would normally teach each day, and students should complete tasks according to their normal timetable.
If students have any questions about the tasks set, they should contact their teachers via email or the chat feature in Teams.
In the event of an extended school closure, live lessons will be delivered using Microsoft Teams. Further details will be provided if this becomes necessary.

Catering
Your Innovate School Restaurant
We’ve teamed up with Innovate, part of Impact Food Group, to create a school dining experience that’s modern, exciting, and full of choice.
Whether students are grabbing something on the go or sitting down with friends for a hot meal, there’s something for everyone – every single day.
Our school’s food is made fresh on site by a friendly, skilled catering team using great quality ingredients parents and students can trust – and the menu is packed with variety, flavour and plenty of options to suit every appetite.
What’s on the Menu?
Students, whether you’re after a quick bite between lessons or something to properly fill you up at lunchtime, here’s what you’ll find:
Hearty, filling main meals that change every day. Think popular favourites like roast dinners and pasta bakes – with every dish served up with veggie sides and a pudding.
Perfect for busy lunchtimes or when you're short on time – sandwiches, wraps, salads, paninis, pasta pots, and more. Freshly made, easy to carry, and always packed with flavour.
A great choice of vegetarian and vegan-friendly options, including fresh salads, wraps, fruit pots and baked snacks.
This is where bold flavours meet personal choice. StreetVibes brings the world’s street food to your school – from sizzling noodles to loaded mac & cheese and flavour-packed shawarma.
Each week, a different concept takes centre stage, but the ordering stays simple: choose a base, add a protein, top it your way – offering over 20 meal combos per concept.
Look out for items marked with the Chill Deal logo – these are part of our great value cold meal deal. This quick and convenient option works like high-street meal deals – grab 4 cold items from our fridges for the free school meal price of a free school meal
Theme Days & Specials
Watch out for special themed menus throughout the year, designed to celebrate cultural and festive events, showcase new dishes and global flavours, and bring some extra fun to the restaurant. Think festive Christmas lunches, Chinese New Year inspired feasts, sporty specials during major tournaments, and mood-boosting treats during exam season – there’s always something to look forward to.
We're serious about doing good while eating well. Our menus are built on a foundation of:
We’re always listening. Whether you’ve got a menu suggestion or just want to shout out your favourite dish, we’d love to hear from you. Drop us a line at:
hello@impactfood.co.uk
Year-7 welcome video
Free School Meals are available for any student whose families meet the Hampshire County Council eligibility criteria.
If you would like further information and details on registering for Free School Meals, below:
Students entitled to free school meals can enjoy a full hot main meal and dessert of the day, or they can mix things up with options from StreetVibes and Chill Deal – all available within the allowance.
Breakfast and breaktime offers are also available as part of the FSM allowance – so you’ll never miss out.
Cashless Catering System
We operate a cashless catering system, using the latest biometric technology and eliminating the need for students to carry cash throughout the day.
The system simply recognises the ​biometric reading of your child’s thumb at the tills.
Students will each be given an account and any amount of money can be paid into it. Anything spent on food and drink will be deducted on a daily basis. Accounts are easily topped up online via Scopay.
We require consent from at least one parent for the biometric information of your child to be processed. For frequently asked questions and an opt-in form please click on the attachments at the bottom of the page​.​
Refectory Opening Times
The Refectory is open from Monday to Friday at the following times and the Snack Shack is available to purchase food during morning break and lunch:
BREAKFAST: 07:30 to 08:30 Serving sausage and bacon baguettes. Hot chocolate will be served during the autumn and winter terms with new items to be added soon!
MORNING BREAK: 11:00 to 11:20 Delicious hot and cold snacks are available.
LUNCH: 13:20 to 14:00 Serving main meals, including pasta and ​home made sauces, street food, sandwiches, wraps and baguettes, fruit muffins and biscuits, fresh fruit, salad pots, vegetable and dip pots. Drinks include fruit juice, carton milk and bottled water.

Eggar’s Together: PTA
Eggar’s Together
Creating Connections. Raising Funds. Shaping Futures.
We're a community of parents and staff (formerly the PTA) working together to help every Eggar’s student thrive—through connection, time, and collective support.
How We Support Our School
Creative Fundraising We raise funds through fun, community events to support department bids for equipment, experiences, and resources that enrich student life. As requests grow each year, your donations make a vital difference. Donate today: www.justgiving.com/eggarstogether
Moments That Matter From the Year 7 Disco to Colour Runs and Mega Eggar’s Easter, we support inclusive events that spark joy, build connection, and create lasting memories.
Grant Funding We secure over £10,000 annually in grants for projects that align with the school’s goals—recent wins include new guitars, cookers, and a laser cutter.
"Thanks to the collective effort of Eggars Together—including parents who helped write the bid— we secured a full class set of guitars—an exciting boost for music at Eggar’s. These guitars are used weekly by our Year 7 and 8 students and also benefit our GCSE musicians. For our passionate class music teachers, having the right equipment is vital to inspire a love for music-making. These instruments are more than tools—they're a ‘leg up’ that helps foster ensembles, energise lessons, and nurture a lifelong passion for music in every student. Having parents able to support and write a bid like this makes a real difference to what our students experience in the classroom."
How You Can Help
Share Your Connections Know someone or work locally? Let us know—we’ll handle the rest. Community links benefit both our students and the wider area.
Give Your Time Just 3 hours a year can make a big impact. Every bit helps.
Donate £20 Annually A small gift can unlock big opportunities. Help us say “yes” more often to staff bids and student needs. Donate online: www.justgiving.com/eggarstogether
Thank you for your support—together, we make a difference.
Join Us Every bit of time, skill, or support helps. Complete our form and send it to:
eggarsptasecretary@gmail.com
Eggar’s School Office or Eggar’s School, London Road, Holybourne, Alton, Hampshire, GU34 4EQ
